prompt:
Create a new KFB ink blob monster character sheet, The Uncertain Lift. Supplied original PNGs are style inputs for rounded ink anatomy, thick modeled lids, plasticine surface and handcrafted accessory scale. Create exactly SIX full individual upright actors in a 3-column by 2-row landscape 1536×1024 PNG with a true transparent alpha backdrop. Each actor at equal substantial scale inside their own logical cell, entire prop and all droplets inside generous transparent gutters and outer margin. No scenery, floor, labels, border, branding, joined figures or background color. Each is a dark charcoal continuous footless ink splat with subtle plum sheen and rich softly rounded clay, small goo hands, bare goo base and expressive asymmetrical organic lobes. Compact costume pieces wrap the blob. Thick filled dark lids with white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Teeth inside lips. Offbeat tourist satire, six different poses, looks and mouth shapes. Visible wear and miniature handcrafted volume. No copied eyepatches, wings, military insignia or outfits from references. Wardrobe family: fluorescent thrift-shop windbreakers, corduroy wraps, faded patches and battered packs. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read optimistic hitchhiker: lean bouncy blob, hopeful wide eyes, crooked toothy smile. Prop: oversized gloved thumb gesture and blank cardboard sign.
2. Male-read appalled detour traveller: wide bent body, uneven open eyes, clenched inner teeth. Prop: small road map with a boldly doubled-back route.
3. Male-read smug roadside repairer: square low blob, heavy side-eye, closed smile. Prop: small duct tape roll and scuffed backpack buckle.
4. Female-read weary roadside camper: slumped teardrop, lids half closed, downturned thin mouth. Prop: rolled sleeping bag with a pocket lantern.
5. Male-read skeptical roadside negotiator: round asymmetrical body, one raised lid, tight pout. Prop: miniature stuffed travel duffel with stitched handle.
6. Male-read startled road tripper: tall scalloped blob, two wide off-axis eyes, tiny oval gasp. Prop: crumpled snack bag and giant empty water bottle.
Emphasize eyes and acting. Keep every figure independently usable as a sightseeing bystander. Hold props close. Separate all six in clear alpha.
